scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
scheme_description: World's largest government-funded healthcare program providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospital care coverage across empanelled public and private hospitals.
eligibility: Households identified as deprived rural clusters or specific occupational categories of urban workers based on SECC 2011 data, NFSA ration card lists, or state-specific low-income databases.
benefits_money: Up to Rs 5,00,000 cashless health coverage per family per year on a family floater basis.
age_limit: No age limit. All family members are covered.
income_limit: Varies by state identification; generally capped at BPL / NFSA priority household thresholds (typically under Rs 1,80,000 to Rs 2,50,000 annual income).
documents: Ration Card or PM-JAY Family ID letter
application_process: Check eligibility via beneficiary portal or visit an empanelled hospital/CSC. Complete biometric e-KYC with an Ayushman Mitra or CSC operator to generate the Ayushman Card.
source_and_verification_date: National Health Authority (NHA) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card (PM-JAY for Senior Citizens)
scheme_description: Universal health coverage under PM-JAY exclusively designed for senior citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of economic background.
eligibility: All Indian senior citizens aged 70 years and above, registered via Aadhaar-based age verification.
benefits_money: Dedicated Rs 5,00,000 cashless health insurance cover per year per senior citizen (or shared between 70+ members in a household), over and above existing family covers.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal coverage.
documents: Aadhaar Card (linked to active mobile number for OTP)
application_process: Download Ayushman App or visit the beneficiary portal. Select 'Senior Citizen 70+' registration, complete Aadhaar e-KYC, take a live selfie, and download the instant e-card.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Government initiative ensuring access to high-quality generic medicines, surgical items, and nutraceuticals at affordable prices through specialized retail outlets.
eligibility: Open to all Indian citizens across the country.
benefits_money: 50% to 90% savings on medicine costs compared to branded counterparts.
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Valid doctor prescription (for prescription drugs); over-the-counter purchases require no documents.
application_process: Direct walk-in to any Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendra across the country with a valid medical prescription.
source_and_verification_date: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Provides assured, comprehensive, and quality antenatal care free of cost to pregnant women universally on the 9th day of every month.
eligibility: All pregnant women in their 2nd and 3rd trimesters of pregnancy.
benefits_money: Free medical checkups, diagnostic blood/urine tests, ultrasound scans, iron-folic supplements, and specialist OB-GYN consultations.
age_limit: No age limit for pregnant women.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Visit any government primary health centre, community health centre, or district hospital on the 9th day of each month.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Nationwide flagship immunization campaign targeting unvaccinated and partially vaccinated infants and pregnant women to prevent childhood mortality.
eligibility: All infants and children up to 2 years of age, children up to 5 years for catch-up doses, and pregnant women.
benefits_money: Free vaccines protecting against 12 vaccine-preventable life-threatening illnesses.
age_limit: Children aged 0 to 5 years and pregnant women.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal free access.
application_process: Visit local Anganwadi centres, Urban Primary Health Centres (UPHCs), or government sub-centres during designated immunization days.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission promoting institutional deliveries among low-income pregnant women to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
eligibility: Pregnant women delivering at government healthcare institutions or accredited private hospitals; universal in Low Performing States (LPS), BPL/SC/ST restricted in High Performing States (HPS).
benefits_money: Cash assistance ranging from Rs 1,000 to Rs 1,400 in rural areas and Rs 900 to Rs 1,000 in urban areas, credited directly via DBT.
age_limit: 19 years and above (in HPS states); universal in LPS states.
income_limit: BPL cardholder verification in High Performing States; universal in Low Performing States.
documents: Bank account details linked with Aadhaar
application_process: Register pregnancy with the local ASHA or ANM worker at the nearest Anganwadi or PHC and deliver at an accredited facility.
source_and_verification_date: National Health Mission (NHM) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Direct benefit transfer maternity scheme providing partial compensation for wage loss and supporting maternal and infant nutrition.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first living child, and for a second child if that child is a girl.
benefits_money: Rs 5,00,000 in two installments for the first child; Rs 6,000 in a single installment for a second girl child.
age_limit: 19 years and above at the time of pregnancy.
income_limit: Family income below Rs 8,00,000 per annum, or holding an EWS/BPL/e-Shram card.
documents: Aadhaar Card of mother and husband
application_process: Apply online through the PMMVY citizen portal or submit Form 1A/1B/1C via local Anganwadi worker or ASHA.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Nutritional direct cash support program for all registered tuberculosis patients under treatment in the national tuberculosis elimination initiative.
eligibility: All tuberculosis patients notified on the central Ni-kshay web portal who are undergoing standard anti-TB therapy.
benefits_money: Rs 500 to Rs 1,000 per month credited directly to the patient's bank account for the entire duration of treatment.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal for all notified TB patients.
documents: Bank account details linked to Aadhaar
application_process: Patient details are uploaded to the Ni-kshay portal by the diagnosing doctor or government health worker; DBT is triggered automatically upon verification.
source_and_verification_date: Central TB Division, MoHFW / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Emergency financial aid scheme for patients living below the poverty line suffering from life-threatening major medical illnesses requiring treatment at super-specialty government hospitals.
eligibility: Patients living below poverty line (BPL) diagnosed with life-threatening disorders requiring treatment at designated premier government hospitals.
benefits_money: One-time financial medical assistance up to Rs 15,00,000 (and up to Rs 20,00,000 for rare diseases under the Rare Diseases policy).
income_limit: Strictly limited to families living below the poverty line (BPL threshold of the respective state).
documents: BPL Ration Card or valid Income Certificate
Medical treatment estimate and proforma signed by treating government hospital head
application_process: Submit the standard RAN application proforma through the Medical Superintendent of the treating designated government hospital to the MoHFW.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Comprehensive, 24/7 digital tele-mental health service delivering free psychiatric counseling, psychological support, and clinical triage across India.
eligibility: Open universally to any individual seeking mental health guidance, psychological support, or suicide prevention intervention.
benefits_money: Free professional clinical counseling and psychological support. No monetary payout.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal access.
documents: No documents required. Completely anonymous and confidential.
application_process: Dial the toll-free helpline number 14416 or 1800-891-4416 from any telephone or mobile network in India.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: National mission for comprehensive financial inclusion ensuring universal access to banking services, basic savings accounts, credit, and remittance.
eligibility: Any Indian resident who does not have an existing basic savings bank account.
benefits_money: Zero minimum balance account, free RuPay debit card, Rs 2,00,000 accidental insurance coverage, and overdraft facility up to Rs 10,000.
age_limit: 10 years and above (overdraft facility available for ages 18 to 65).
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Visit any public or private commercial bank branch, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Bank Mitra kiosk and fill out the PMJDY account opening form.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Financial Services (DFS), MoF / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Government-backed personal accident insurance scheme offering affordable protection against death or permanent total disability.
eligibility: All savings bank or post office account holders who provide auto-debit consent.
benefits_money: Rs 2,00,000 for accidental death or total permanent disability; Rs 1,00,000 for permanent partial disability. Annual premium: Rs 20.
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Active Bank / Post Office Savings Account passbook
application_process: Opt-in through net banking, mobile banking app, or submit an enrollment form at your home bank branch or post office.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Financial Services (DFS), MoF / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
scheme_description: Government-backed one-year renewable group life insurance scheme providing life cover for death due to any cause.
eligibility: Any individual having a savings bank or post office account who consents to enable auto-debit for annual premiums.
benefits_money: Rs 2,00,000 life insurance sum assured payable to the nominee upon death of the subscriber due to any cause. Annual premium: Rs 436.
age_limit: 18 to 50 years (coverage up to age 55 provided premium is paid continuously).
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Active Bank / Post Office Savings Account details
application_process: Apply via internet banking or fill and submit the PMJJBY enrollment form at your local bank branch or India Post Payments Bank branch.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Financial Services (DFS), MoF / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Government-administered guaranteed voluntary pension scheme designed to provide social and old-age security to workers in the unorganized sector.
eligibility: All Indian citizens having a bank account who are not existing income taxpayers and are not covered under statutory social security schemes.
benefits_money: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs 1,00,000, Rs 2,00,000, Rs 3,00,000, Rs 4,00,000, or Rs 5,00,000 from age 60 until death, followed by spouse pension and corpus return to nominee.
income_limit: Subscribers must not be income tax payers.
application_process: Submit the APY application form at your bank branch or register via net banking/mobile banking by authorizing auto-debit contributions.
source_and_verification_date: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
scheme_description: Non-contributory central social assistance pension scheme for elderly citizens living below the poverty line.
eligibility: Senior citizens belonging to officially recognized Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
benefits_money: Rs 200 to Rs 500 per month central assistance (frequently supplemented by state governments up to Rs 1,000 - Rs 3,000 per month).
income_limit: Must be below the official poverty line (BPL).
application_process: Submit the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) application form to the local Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal office, or apply via the NSAP portal.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
scheme_description: Social welfare monthly pension assistance provided to destitute widows living in poverty.
eligibility: Widows belonging to officially documented Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
benefits_money: Rs 300 to Rs 500 per month central share (often topped up by states to Rs 1,500 - Rs 2,500 per month).
age_limit: 40 to 79 years (transitions to IGNOAPS at age 80).
income_limit: Must belong to a certified BPL household.
application_process: Submit the filled application with death certificate and BPL card to the local Panchayat office, Municipal corporation, or online on the NSAP portal.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
scheme_description: Monthly disability pension scheme extended to severely disabled destitute persons.
eligibility: Persons with severe disability (certified 80% and above disability or multiple disabilities) from BPL households.
benefits_money: Rs 300 to Rs 500 per month central share (augmented significantly by state-level top-up schemes).
income_limit: Must belong to a verified BPL family.
documents: Disability Certificate (minimum 80% disability) or UDID Card
application_process: Apply through the district Social Welfare Officer, Block Development Officer, or register on the central NSAP portal.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Small-deposit sovereign savings scheme aimed at building an education and marriage corpus for a girl child with guaranteed high interest.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child resident in India; maximum two accounts per family (three in case of twin/triplet girls).
benefits_money: High sovereign interest rate (typically 8.2%+ p.a.), compounding annually with full triple tax exemption (EEE status under Section 80C).
age_limit: From birth up to 10 years of age of the girl child.
income_limit: No income limit. Minimum annual deposit Rs 250, maximum Rs 1,50,000 per financial year.
documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
application_process: Fill the SSY account opening form and submit initial deposit at any authorized public/private commercial bank or post office branch.
source_and_verification_date: National Savings Institute / Department of Economic Affairs, MoF, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Long-term government-backed statutory savings vehicle offering risk-free capital accumulation and income tax deductions.
eligibility: All Indian resident individuals. (Can also be opened on behalf of a minor child).
benefits_money: Guaranteed quarterly sovereign interest rate, loan/partial withdrawal facilities, and complete tax exemption on investment, interest, and maturity.
income_limit: No income limit. Minimum deposit Rs 500, maximum Rs 1,50,000 per financial year.
application_process: Open instantly online through your bank's net banking portal or visit any designated post office or bank branch with KYC documents.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Sovereign-backed fixed-income savings product offering retirees high interest returns and secure regular quarterly income.
eligibility: Indian residents aged 60 and above, or retired civilian employees aged 55 to 60, and defense retirees aged 50+ subject to retirement deposit timelines.
benefits_money: Guaranteed quarterly interest payouts; maximum investment ceiling up to Rs 30,00,000 with 80C tax deduction.
age_limit: 60 years and above (55 years for voluntary retirees).
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Retirement proof / employer superannuation certificate (for individuals below 60)
application_process: Submit Form-1 at any post office or authorized commercial bank along with initial investment cheque and identity proofs.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Finance / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U / PMAY-U 2.0)
scheme_description: Flagship urban housing mission providing central interest subvention and direct financial grants to enable poor and middle-income families to own a pucca home.
eligibility: Families belonging to EWS, LIG, or MIG categories who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
benefits_money: Direct financial assistance or interest subsidy of up to Rs 1,50,000 to Rs 2,67,000 depending on category and component.
income_limit: EWS: Up to Rs 3,00,000 p.a.; LIG: Rs 3,00,001 to Rs 6,00,000 p.a.; MIG: Up to Rs 9,00,000 p.a.
documents: Affidavit declaring no pucca house owned
application_process: Apply online through the PMAY-Urban portal, CSC centre, or through the respective urban local body (Municipality).
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Rural housing welfare initiative delivering financial grants directly into beneficiary bank accounts to construct permanent houses with basic amenities.
eligibility: Rural households listed as houseless or living in zero-, one-, or two-room kutcha houses in SECC 2011 and validated Awas+ survey lists.
benefits_money: Financial assistance of Rs 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/northeastern states, plus MGNREGA labor wages and toilet subsidy.
income_limit: Identified automatically via rural poverty deprivation criteria (typically annual income below Rs 1,20,000).
application_process: Selection is handled by the Gram Sabha based on the Awas+ database. Beneficiaries are registered by the Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Clean cooking fuel scheme providing deposit-free LPG connections to poor households to improve health and eliminate indoor air pollution.
eligibility: Adult woman belonging to poor/deprived households (SC/ST, PMAY beneficiaries, Antyodaya, Most Backward Classes, or rural poor declaration).
benefits_money: Free LPG connection with zero deposit fee, free first LPG refill cylinder, free cooking stove, and per-cylinder targeted subsidy.
income_limit: Must belong to an economically vulnerable household lacking an active LPG connection.
documents: Aadhaar Card of the applicant and adult family members
Ration Card or self-declaration of family composition
application_process: Apply online on the PMUY portal or submit an application form at the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas).
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoPNG) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
scheme_description: Rooftop solar initiative providing direct central capital subsidies to residential households to generate solar power and receive up to 300 free units of electricity.
eligibility: Indian residential households with a suitable shadow-free roof and an active domestic grid electricity connection.
benefits_money: Capital subsidy of Rs 30,000 for 1 kW, Rs 60,000 for 2 kW, and up to Rs 78,000 for 3 kW and above solar rooftop systems.
age_limit: 18 years and above (electricity consumer account holder).
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Bank account details linked to Aadhaar
application_process: Register on the National Rooftop Solar Portal, enter electricity consumer number, select a registered vendor, get DISCOM feasibility approval, and receive DBT upon installation.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: National initiative ensuring provision of safe and adequate drinking water through individual Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household.
eligibility: Every rural household in all villages across India.
benefits_money: Free provision of piped potable drinking water connection supplying at least 55 litres per capita per day. No monetary grant.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal rural coverage.
documents: Aadhaar Card (for local village consumer registry)
application_process: Community-driven planning executed through the Village Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC) / Gram Panchayat.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Sanitation mission aimed at eliminating open defecation in rural India by providing financial assistance to build Individual Household Latrines (IHHL).
eligibility: Rural households that do not have an individual sanitary toilet, prioritizing BPL and identified APL (SC/ST, disabled, small/marginal farmers) families.
benefits_money: Financial incentive grant of Rs 12,000 directly transferred to build an individual sanitary household latrine.
income_limit: BPL households or vulnerable APL categories.
documents: Photograph of the beneficiary with the newly constructed toilet
application_process: Apply online on the SBM-Gramin portal or submit an IHHL request through the local Gram Panchayat Secretary.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Jal Shakti / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Urban sanitation and waste management initiative dedicated to achieving garbage-free cities, sustainable sanitation, and safe faecal sludge processing.
eligibility: Urban poor and low-income slum households without private access to a household toilet.
benefits_money: Financial subsidy of Rs 4,000 to Rs 8,000 (supplemented by state grants) to construct an individual household sanitary toilet.
income_limit: Low-income urban households and slum residents.
documents: Urban resident proof / municipal property tax receipt
application_process: Apply online on the SBM-Urban portal or apply directly at the Ward office of your Urban Local Body (ULB).
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
scheme_description: Micro-credit collateral-free working capital facility for urban and peri-urban street vendors to revive businesses and integrate into digital payments.
eligibility: Street vendors and hawkers vending in urban areas possessing a Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by Urban Local Bodies.
benefits_money: Collateral-free working capital loan: 1st tranche Rs 10,000; 2nd tranche Rs 20,000; 3rd tranche Rs 50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy and digital cashback up to Rs 1,200/year.
income_limit: No specific income limit; verified street vending profession.
documents: Vending Certificate / Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Municipality
application_process: Apply online via the PM SVANidhi portal, through local municipal offices, or through banking correspondents and CSCs.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: National Urban Digital Mission / DigiLocker Citizen Services
scheme_description: Digital public infrastructure framework delivering paperless, tamper-proof issuance and verification of citizen documents, certificates, and municipal licenses.
eligibility: All citizens holding an Aadhaar number.
benefits_money: Free digital storage, legal equivalence to original physical documents under IT Act, and zero fees for fetching certificates.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Download the DigiLocker App or sign up on the DigiLocker portal using your mobile number and Aadhaar e-KYC.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana (Saubhagya)
scheme_description: Universal household electrification scheme providing last-mile electricity grid connectivity and power access to un-electrified households.
eligibility: Un-electrified poor households in rural and urban areas identified through SECC data.
benefits_money: Free electricity connection, service wire, energy meter, and LED pack; nominal connection fee of Rs 500 (in 10 installments) for non-poor households.
income_limit: Free for BPL/SECC households; paid in installments for others.
application_process: Electrification camps organized directly by DISCOMs in villages or apply at the local electricity distribution sub-station.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Power / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Direct income support program providing assured cash transfer to all cultivable landholding farmer families across India.
eligibility: Farmer families holding cultivable agricultural land registered in state land revenue records (excluding institutional landowners and high income/income tax-paying professionals).
benefits_money: Rs 6,000 per year transferred directly to bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments of Rs 2,000.
income_limit: Excludes individuals who paid income tax in the last assessment year or receive superannuation/pension over Rs 10,000/month.
application_process: Self-register on the PM-KISAN portal under 'Farmers Corner' or visit the nearest CSC / local revenue agriculture officer.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Comprehensive, actuarial crop insurance coverage protecting farmers against financial losses caused by natural calamities, pests, and localized weather hazards.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.
benefits_money: Full sum insured payout against crop loss; low farmer premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi food/oilseed crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari/revenue official
application_process: Apply online on the National Crop Insurance Portal, via the Crop Insurance App, through bank branches, or at CSC centres before the cut-off date.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Concessional, single-window institutional credit facility providing timely short-term credit to farmers for crop cultivation, animal husbandry, and fisheries.
eligibility: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, self-help groups, and allied livestock/fish farmers.
benefits_money: Revolving credit limit up to Rs 3,00,000 at a low effective interest rate of 4% per annum (with 3% prompt repayment incentive). Up to Rs 1.6 lakh collateral-free.
age_limit: 18 to 75 years (co-borrower mandatory for applicants above 60).
income_limit: No income limit; credit limit determined by scale of finance, cropped area, and cropping pattern.
documents: No-dues certificate from nearby financial institutions
application_process: Submit the standard one-page KCC application form at your local commercial, cooperative, or Regional Rural Bank branch.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Provides farmers with crop-wise nutrient status and tailored fertilizer recommendations to improve soil fertility and reduce input expenditure.
eligibility: All farmers owning cultivable agricultural land across India.
benefits_money: Free physical and digital report containing soil fertility status across 12 parameters and dosage recommendations. No direct monetary payment.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: State Agriculture Department officials collect soil samples directly from farm plots; cards are generated and distributed every 2 years.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop)
scheme_description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems like drip and sprinkler technology to enhance on-farm water use efficiency and maximize crop productivity.
eligibility: All landholding farmers, members of cooperative societies, and self-help groups owning cultivable land with an assured water source.
benefits_money: Capital subsidy of up to 55% for small/marginal farmers and up to 45% for other farmers on micro-irrigation equipment costs.
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Electricity connection details / water source proof
application_process: Apply through the State Horticulture or Agriculture Department portal or visit the district agriculture office.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
eligibility: Any farmer, trader, or Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) trading in notified agricultural commodities.
benefits_money: Transparent competitive online bidding, elimination of middleman commissions, and direct online payment settlement into bank accounts.
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: APMC gate entry receipt / Mandi license (for traders)
application_process: Register online on the e-NAM portal or approach the registration kiosk at any integrated APMC mandi with land and bank details.
source_and_verification_date: Small Farmers' Agri-Business Consortium (SFAC) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Sub-component of National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture promoting commercial organic farming through cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System certification.
eligibility: Farmers willing to form clusters of 50 acres (or 20 hectares) to practice chemical-free natural/organic farming.
benefits_money: Rs 50,000 per hectare financial assistance over 3 years, of which Rs 31,000 is given directly to the farmer for organic inputs.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Form a cluster with neighboring farmers and apply through the Regional Council or District Agriculture Officer.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Subsidies for small and marginal farmers to acquire farm machinery and promote Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) in rural regions.
eligibility: Individual farmers, cooperative societies, Farmer Producer Organizations, and registered farm self-help groups.
benefits_money: 40% to 50% subsidy on procurement cost of agricultural equipment (tractors, power tillers, rotavators) or up to Rs 10 lakh for setting up CHCs.
income_limit: No income limit; higher subsidy preference for SC, ST, women, and small/marginal landholders.
application_process: Register on the centralized Direct Benefit Transfer in Agriculture Mechanization portal and select preferred machinery and dealer.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Comprehensive framework dedicated to ecologically responsible modernization, production enhancement, and post-harvest infrastructure in aquaculture and fisheries.
eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, fisheries cooperatives, and private entrepreneurs.
benefits_money: Government financial assistance of 40% of project cost for General category and up to 60% for SC, ST, and women beneficiaries.
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Land or water body lease/ownership deed
application_process: Submit project proposal on the PMMSY portal or through the District Fisheries Officer (DFO).
source_and_verification_date: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Sustainable development initiative providing capital subsidies to encourage entrepreneurship in poultry, sheep, goat, and pig breeding, as well as fodder production.
eligibility: Individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs, Joint Liability Groups, and Section 8 companies.
benefits_money: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs 25,00,000 for poultry projects and up to Rs 50,00,000 for sheep, goat, and pig breeding farms.
income_limit: No income limit; must demonstrate equity contribution or bank loan sanction.
documents: Land ownership/lease documents for farm site
application_process: Apply online through the NLM entrepreneurship portal; proposals are appraised by State Level Executive Committees and funding routed through SIDBI.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Pan-India medium-to-long term financing facility to create post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, agri-entrepreneurs, startups, and self-help groups.
benefits_money: 3% annual interest subvention on bank loans up to Rs 2,00,000,000 (2 crore) for a maximum of 7 years, along with CGTMSE credit guarantee fee coverage.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Register and submit the project application online on the AIF portal. Once cleared by the Ministry, it is forwarded directly to the chosen bank for loan sanction.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: National initiative to construct or rejuvenate at least 75 community water bodies (Amrit Sarovars) in every district of India to address water scarcity.
eligibility: Rural village communities, Gram Panchayats, and local user water associations.
benefits_money: Community asset creation; no direct beneficiary cash payouts. Provides local wage employment under MGNREGA convergence.
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Gram Panchayat resolution / site identification survey
application_process: Execution implemented by District Administration and Gram Panchayats through convergence of MGNREGA, XV Finance Commission grants, and CSR.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN / Mid-Day Meal)
scheme_description: National school feeding program providing hot cooked nutritious lunches to primary and upper primary students in government-run and aided schools.
eligibility: All students enrolled in classes 1 to 8 in government, government-aided, local body, and special training centres.
benefits_money: Free cooked meal meeting standardized nutritional quotas (minimum 450 calories and 12g protein for primary; 700 calories and 20g protein for upper primary). No direct cash.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal for all enrolled students.
application_process: Automatic entitlement upon enrolling in any eligible government or government-aided school.
source_and_verification_date: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Integrated scheme for school education spanning from pre-school to class 12, focusing on inclusive learning, free learning kits, and school quality.
eligibility: Children enrolled in government and local authority schools across India.
benefits_money: Free textbooks, free uniforms (up to Rs 600/year), transport allowance, and special education allowances for children with special needs (CWSN).
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Benefits are delivered through the government school where the student is enrolled.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Education / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme awarded to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts after class 8.
eligibility: Students studying in class 8 in government/aided schools securing minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) who clear the state NMMSS selection exam.
benefits_money: Rs 12,000 per annum (Rs 1,000 per month) disbursed directly via DBT from class 9 through class 12.
income_limit: Parents' total annual income from all sources must not exceed Rs 3,50,000.
application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) after qualifying in the state-level NMMSS examination.
source_and_verification_date: Department of School Education and Literacy, MoE / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Centrally sponsored scholarship providing comprehensive financial aid to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students pursuing higher education.
eligibility: SC and ST students pursuing recognized post-secondary or tertiary courses (classes 11, 12, ITI, diploma, degree, masters, doctorate).
benefits_money: Complete reimbursement of non-refundable compulsory tuition fees plus monthly academic maintenance allowance (up to Rs 13,500/year).
income_limit: Total family annual income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000.
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or respective State Scholarship Portals, verified by the educational institution.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC and Vulnerable Groups
scheme_description: Financial scholarship to support education of children belonging to SC and disadvantaged communities in classes 9 and 10 to minimize dropouts.
eligibility: Students belonging to SC or engaged in occupations involving cleaning and prone to health hazards, studying full-time in classes 9 or 10.
benefits_money: Rs 3,500 to Rs 7,000 per annum academic allowance plus book grants credited directly via DBT.
income_limit: Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 (no income ceiling for children of manual scavengers/cleaners).
documents: Caste certificate or parent's occupation certificate
application_process: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or State Welfare Department portal with verification by school authorities.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP)
scheme_description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for meritorious college students to support daily living expenses during graduate and postgraduate studies.
eligibility: Students who score above the 80th percentile in their relevant stream in Class 12 board examinations and are enrolled in regular full-time degree programs.
benefits_money: Rs 12,000 per annum for the first 3 years of graduation; Rs 20,000 per annum during postgraduate studies.
income_limit: Gross parental annual income must not exceed Rs 4,50,000.
application_process: Register and submit application on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP); verified by college and State Nodal Officer.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loan scheme providing interest subvention for students admitted to India's top 860+ higher education institutions.
eligibility: Students securing admission into top NIRF-ranked institutions for recognized undergraduate/postgraduate degree courses.
benefits_money: Collateral-free loan covering full tuition and course-related expenses, plus a 3% interest subvention during moratorium for family income up to Rs 8 lakh.
income_limit: Full interest subvention requires family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh; 3% interest subvention requires family income up to Rs 8,00,000.
documents: Admission letter from qualifying NIRF institution
application_process: Apply directly on the unified PM-Vidyalaxmi digital portal; digital loan sanctions are handled with automated interest subsidies.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (AICTE)
scheme_description: Scholarship advancing technical education among young women admitted to approved technical degree or diploma courses.
eligibility: Female students admitted to the 1st year of a Degree/Diploma course (or 2nd year via lateral entry) at an AICTE-approved institution; maximum two girls per family.
benefits_money: Rs 50,000 per year for every year of study towards college fees, computer purchase, books, and stationeries.
income_limit: Family annual income from all sources must not exceed Rs 8,00,000.
application_process: Submit application online via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with verification conducted by the respective AICTE college.
source_and_verification_date: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students (AICTE)
scheme_description: Financial scholarship to support specially-abled students pursuing professional and technical education in approved colleges.
eligibility: Differently-abled students having not less than 40% certified disability admitted to AICTE-approved degree or diploma courses.
benefits_money: Rs 50,000 per annum for each year of study towards tuition, equipment purchase, and living costs.
income_limit: Family annual income must not exceed Rs 8,00,000.
application_process: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with institutional verification by the AICTE-approved institution.
source_and_verification_date: AICTE / Ministry of Education, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Centrally sponsored child welfare scheme offering institutional and non-institutional care, foster care, and sponsorship for vulnerable children in distress.
eligibility: Orphans, abandoned, runaway, or destitute children, and children of widowed, divorced, or incapacitated parents.
benefits_money: Non-institutional financial sponsorship grant of Rs 4,000 per child per month transferred directly to the foster caregiver's bank account.
income_limit: Family annual income must not exceed Rs 72,000 in rural areas or Rs 96,000 in urban areas.
application_process: Apply through the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) or local Child Welfare Committee (CWC).
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
scheme_description: Statutory demand-driven wage employment scheme guaranteeing 100 days of unskilled manual work per financial year to rural households.
eligibility: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits_money: Guaranteed statutory daily minimum wage (notified per state, ranging from Rs 234 to Rs 374+ per day) directly deposited into bank/post office accounts.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal for rural households.
application_process: Apply for a Job Card at the local Gram Panchayat office. Submit a written or verbal request for work; work must be provided within 15 days or unemployment allowance applies.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Skill development initiative offering free, industry-aligned technical and vocational training, certification, and placement support to unemployed youth.
eligibility: Unemployed Indian youth, school/college dropouts, or individuals wanting to upgrade their technical skills in NSQF-aligned job roles.
benefits_money: 100% free training and assessment, government-recognized NSQF skill certificate, conveyance allowance, and monetary incentive upon passing assessment.
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Educational certificates (based on course entry criteria)
application_process: Register on the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) portal, browse courses, and enroll at an accredited PMKVY training centre.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Government scheme promoting industrial apprenticeship training by sharing stipend costs with employers and integrating youth into workplaces.
eligibility: Individuals who have completed 5th grade or above (typically ITI holders, graduates, diploma holders) seeking structured industrial training.
benefits_money: Monthly stipend paid to apprentices; government reimburses 25% of prescribed stipend up to Rs 1,500 per month directly via DBT.
age_limit: 14 years and above (18 years for hazardous industries).
income_limit: No income limit.
documents: Bank account details linked to Aadhaar
application_process: Register as a candidate on the Apprenticeship India portal and apply for apprenticeship openings posted by registered corporate establishments.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
scheme_description: Poverty relief initiative mobilizing rural women into Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to build community savings, micro-enterprises, and sustainable livelihoods.
eligibility: Rural poor women; at least one woman member from each identified poor household organized into a Self-Help Group (SHG).
benefits_money: Revolving Fund of Rs 20,000 to Rs 30,000 per SHG, Community Investment Support Fund, and collateral-free bank credit up to Rs 20,000,000 at subsidized interest rates.
income_limit: Targeted at rural poor and vulnerable households identified via Participatory Identification of the Poor (PIP).
documents: Bank passbook of SHG and member
application_process: Join or form a village SHG with the help of Community Resource Persons (CRPs) or Gram Panchayat livelihood animators.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
scheme_description: Urban poverty reduction program promoting skill training, development of urban street vendors, self-employment ventures, and shelter for the urban homeless.
eligibility: Urban poor, street vendors, ragpickers, homeless individuals, and urban self-help groups.
benefits_money: Interest subsidy on bank loans for micro-enterprises (up to Rs 2 lakh for individuals, Rs 10 lakh for groups) reducing effective interest to 7%. Free vocational skill training.
income_limit: Urban households living below poverty line or designated low-income categories.
application_process: Apply through the City Livelihoods Centre (CLC) or the Community Organizer at the local Urban Local Body (Municipal Corporation).
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: National database for unorganized workers providing a 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) to deliver targeted social security and disaster relief benefits.
eligibility: Any unorganized worker (construction, domestic worker, gig worker, agricultural laborer, driver) who is not an income tax payer and not an EPFO/ESIC member.
benefits_money: Built-in Rs 2,00,000 accidental death/permanent total disability insurance cover and seamless portability of social welfare schemes.
income_limit: Must not be an income tax assessee.
documents: Aadhaar Card (linked to active mobile number)
application_process: Self-register on the e-Shram portal using Aadhaar OTP verification, or register via Common Service Centres (CSCs) and State Seva Kendras.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Labour and Employment / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Free digital employment portal providing employment matchmaking, job fairs, vocational career counseling, and job market intelligence.
eligibility: All job seekers, students, apprentices, and employers across India.
benefits_money: Free access to private and public sector jobs, career aptitude tests, job search assistance, and subsidized counseling. No direct money transfer.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Sign up for free as a job seeker on the NCS portal, complete your digital profile, and apply directly for job listings and job fairs.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Labour and Employment / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY) / EPFO Employer Support
scheme_description: Incentivizes employers to generate formal employment by reimbursing the entire 12% employer contribution towards EPF and EPS for newly created formal jobs.
eligibility: Establishments registered with EPFO creating new formal jobs with a Universal Account Number (UAN).
benefits_money: Government pays the employer's 12% statutory pension and provident fund contribution for new workers earning up to Rs 15,000/month for 3 years.
income_limit: Employee monthly gross wages must not exceed Rs 15,000.
application_process: The employer logs in to the EPFO Unified Portal and submits new employees' UAN details under the scheme tab.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Labour and Employment / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: ASEEM Portal (Aatmanirbhar Skilled Employee Employer Mapping)
scheme_description: AI-driven talent directory matching certified skilled candidates with local industrial and business workforce demands.
eligibility: Skilled and certified workers in technical, blue-collar, or vocational trades.
benefits_money: Direct job linkages and transparent wage discovery without recruitment agency commissions.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Register your profile through the Skill India Digital Hub or the ASEEM candidate web app.
source_and_verification_date: National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), MSDE, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Transformational four-year recruitment program for youth to serve in the Indian Armed Forces as 'Agniveers'.
eligibility: Unmarried male and female Indian citizens meeting mandatory physical and educational standards for the Armed Forces.
benefits_money: Monthly customized salary (Rs 30,000 to Rs 40,000), Rs 48 lakh non-contributory life cover, and a tax-free 'Seva Nidhi' corpus of ~Rs 11.71 lakh upon 4-year completion.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Apply online during open recruitment cycles on the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force recruitment portals.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Defence / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Collateral-free institutional micro-credit provided to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises for business startup and working capital.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity in manufacturing, trading, or service sectors.
benefits_money: Collateral-free loans in 4 categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5,00,000), Tarun (Rs 5,00,000 to Rs 10,00,000), and Tarun Plus (Rs 10,00,000 to Rs 20,00,000).
income_limit: No formal income limit; determined by business cash-flow assessment.
documents: Business address proof and trade registration
application_process: Apply online via the JanSamarth or Udyamimitra portal, or submit the MUDRA loan form at any commercial bank, RRB, MFI, or NBFC.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Financial Services (DFS), MoF / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: End-to-end support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools across 18 family-based traditional trades.
eligibility: Artisans and craftspeople working in one of the 18 designated trades (e.g., carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, cobbler, mason) based on self-employment.
benefits_money: Free training with Rs 500 daily stipend, Rs 15,000 e-voucher toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs 3,00,000 (Rs 1 lakh first tranche, Rs 2 lakh second tranche) at 5% interest.
income_limit: Limited to one member per family with no government employees in the household.
application_process: Register via biometric authentication at any Common Service Centre (CSC); followed by a 3-stage verification (Gram Panchayat, District, and Screening).
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Credit-linked capital subsidy scheme designed to set up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors to generate non-farm employment.
eligibility: Individuals aged 18+ (minimum 8th class pass for projects above Rs 10 lakh in manufacturing or Rs 5 lakh in services); SHGs and cooperative societies.
benefits_money: Margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost (up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for service units).
income_limit: No ceiling on family income for setting up the project.
application_process: Submit project proposal and online application on the KVIC PMEGP e-portal; evaluated by District Task Force Committee before forwarding to financing bank.
source_and_verification_date: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Bank loan facility promoting greenfield entrepreneurship among women, Scheduled Castes, and Scheduled Tribes in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sectors.
eligibility: SC/ST and women entrepreneurs aged 18+; in non-individual enterprises, at least 51% shareholding must be held by an SC/ST or woman.
benefits_money: Bank composite loans (term loan and working capital) between Rs 10,00,000 and Rs 1,00,00,000 covering up to 85% of project cost.
income_limit: No specific income limit; borrower must not be in default with any financial institution.
application_process: Apply online through the Stand-Up India portal or visit any scheduled commercial bank branch.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Financial Services, MoF / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
scheme_description: Provides financial, technical, and business support for upgrading and formalizing existing unorganized individual micro-food processing units.
eligibility: Existing micro-food processing units, FPOs, Self-Help Groups, and producer cooperatives.
benefits_money: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of Rs 10,00,000 per unit, plus Rs 40,000 seed capital per SHG member.
income_limit: No income limit; ownership of an existing micro food-processing enterprise required.
documents: Proof of food business existence / FSSAI license / electricity bills
application_process: Register on the PMFME portal; District Resource Persons (DRPs) provide handholding support to prepare DPR and submit to the bank.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
scheme_description: Provides credit guarantees to member lending institutions to facilitate collateral-free business loans for micro and small enterprises.
eligibility: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in manufacturing and services.
benefits_money: Collateral-free and third-party-guarantee-free loans up to Rs 5,00,00,000 (5 crore) with 75% to 85% guarantee coverage backed by the trust.
income_limit: No income limit; based on project viability and credit appraisal.
application_process: Apply for a commercial loan at any scheduled bank or NBFC and request coverage under the CGTMSE guarantee scheme.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of MSME and SIDBI, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: National flagship initiative providing tax exemptions, regulatory concessions, fast-track patent processing, and capital access to recognized innovative startups.
eligibility: Entities incorporated as Private Limited, LLP, or Registered Partnership within the past 10 years with annual turnover under Rs 100 crore, working on innovation or scalability.
benefits_money: Access to Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (up to Rs 20 lakh grant and Rs 50 lakh debt/convertibles), 3-year income tax exemption under 80-IAC, and 80% rebate on patent filings.
age_limit: Founders must be 18 years and above.
income_limit: Company turnover under Rs 100 crore in any financial year.
documents: Pitch deck / Brief description of innovative nature of product/service
application_process: Create an account on the Startup India portal and apply online for DPIIT Recognition.
source_and_verification_date: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Zero-cost, paperless self-declaration government registration portal granting permanent digital Udyam identification to micro, small, and medium enterprises.
eligibility: Any business entity falling within MSME criteria based on composite investment in plant/machinery and turnover thresholds.
benefits_money: Unlocks priority sector lending, lower bank interest rates, protection against delayed payments under MSMED Act, and government procurement exemptions.
income_limit: Micro: Investment <= 1 Cr, Turnover <= 5 Cr; Small: Investment <= 10 Cr, Turnover <= 50 Cr; Medium: Investment <= 50 Cr, Turnover <= 250 Cr.
documents: GSTIN (if statutory GST registration is applicable)
application_process: Register online for free on the official Udyam portal by entering Aadhaar and PAN; registration certificate is generated digitally.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Promotes innovation, rural entrepreneurship, and agro-industry setups through Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators (TBIs).
eligibility: Government agencies, universities, technical institutions, and R&D organizations setting up business incubators.
benefits_money: 100% financial grant up to Rs 1,00,00,000 for government agencies (and up to Rs 50 lakh for private agencies) to procure plant and machinery for incubators.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Submit project proposal through the ASPIRE scheme portal, evaluated by the Project Screening Committee of the Ministry of MSME.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of MSME / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Tri-ministerial national initiative to prevent gender-biased sex selection, protect the girl child, and ensure her education and active participation.
eligibility: Targeted at society, girl children, and families with newborn girls across all districts of India.
benefits_money: No direct individual cash transfer. Funds are utilized for institutional reform, community surveillance, school enrollment drives, and girl-child toilet construction.
age_limit: Girl children from birth to 18 years.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal campaign.
documents: Not applicable (programmatic advocacy and institutional interventions).
application_process: Civic, education, and health departments coordinate institutional interventions, maternal health tracking, and school enrollment drives at district level.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Women and Child Development / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Provides institutional support, short-stay shelter, food, clothing, medical care, and economic rehabilitation to women in difficult life situations.
eligibility: Destitute women, widows deserted by family, survivors of domestic violence, released female prisoners, and female victims of trafficking.
benefits_money: Free temporary shelter, meals, clothing, legal counsel, and vocational rehabilitation up to 3 years (up to 5 years for women above 55). No direct cash grant.
age_limit: Women aged 18 years and above (and accompanying children: girls up to 18, boys up to 8).
income_limit: Destitute and marginalized women without financial means.
documents: Aadhaar Card (if available; absence does not preclude immediate admission)
application_process: Direct walk-in or referral by police, One Stop Centre, District Social Welfare Officer, or Child/Women Helpline (181/112).
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Women and Child Development / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Integrated 24/7 crisis response centres providing emergency medical aid, legal aid, police assistance, and psychological counseling to women facing violence.
eligibility: Any woman or girl facing physical, sexual, emotional, psychological, or economic abuse, whether in public or private spaces.
benefits_money: Free immediate medical examination, legal assistance, counseling, and temporary shelter up to 5 days. No cash payouts.
age_limit: No age limit. Accessible to all girls and women.
income_limit: No income limit. Universal access.
documents: No documents required for immediate rescue and support.
application_process: Visit the local Sakhi One Stop Centre situated adjacent to district hospitals, or dial Women Helpline 181 or Emergency 112.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Women and Child Development / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY / NFSA)
scheme_description: Ensures national food security by providing free food grains monthly to vulnerable and poor households via the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS).
eligibility: Beneficiaries covered under Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
benefits_money: Free food grains: 5 kg per person per month for Priority Households (PHH); 35 kg per family per month for Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families.
income_limit: Households identified under state-specific NFSA socio-economic guidelines and BPL lists.
application_process: Collect monthly food grains at any Fair Price Shop (FPS) using biometric authentication via One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC).
source_and_verification_date: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Provides free physical assisted-living devices and age-related disability aids to senior citizens belonging to economically vulnerable households.
eligibility: Senior citizens suffering from age-related infirmities or disabilities belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families or earning less than Rs 15,000/month.
benefits_money: Free distribution of modern assisted-living devices: wheelchairs, walking sticks, crutches, hearing aids, artificial dentures, and spectacles.
income_limit: Monthly income must not exceed Rs 15,00,000, or applicant must possess a valid BPL ration card.
documents: BPL Certificate or Income certificate (below Rs 15,000/month)
application_process: Register on the ALIMCO portal or attend district assessment camps conducted by ALIMCO and the District Social Welfare Department.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
scheme_description: Provides free or subsidized durable, sophisticated assistive aids and modern prosthetics to persons with disabilities to promote physical independence.
eligibility: Indian citizens with minimum 40% certified disability holding a valid disability certificate or UDID card.
benefits_money: Free aids and appliances (wheelchairs, motorized tricycles, braille kits, prosthetics, hearing aids, cochlear implants up to Rs 6 lakh for children under 5).
age_limit: No age limit (cochlear implants prioritized for children up to 5 years).
income_limit: 100% free aids for monthly income up to Rs 22,500; 50% subsidy for income between Rs 22,501 and Rs 30,000 per month.
application_process: Apply online on the ADIP portal or attend localized identification and distribution camps organized by ALIMCO and district agencies.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Verified: October 2026

scheme_description: Single pan-India biometric-enabled smart card capturing disability records to provide transparent, seamless access to state and central welfare benefits.
eligibility: All persons with disabilities (Divyangjan) residing in India across all 21 categories recognized under the RPwD Act 2016.
benefits_money: Paperless universal disability ID card granting access to free transport passes, reservations, scholarships, assistive aids, and medical pensions.
income_limit: No income limit.
application_process: Apply online on the Swavlamban portal; visit designated District Medical Hospital for medical evaluation; download digital e-UDID card.
source_and_verification_date: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
scheme_description: National action plan offering free skill development, upskilling, and vocational certifications with training stipends to marginalized communities.
eligibility: Candidates belonging to SC, OBC, Economically Backward Classes (EBC), De-notified Tribes (DNT), and Safai Karamcharis.
benefits_money: 100% free training and assessment, plus a stipend of Rs 1,000 to Rs 1,500 per month for non-residential training programmes.
income_limit: No income limit for SC, DNT, and Safai Karamcharis; family income below Rs 3,00,000/year for OBCs; below Rs 1,00,000/year for EBCs.
application_process: Register on the PM-DAKSH portal or mobile app, select preferred course and training institute, and complete admission upon batch allotment.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / myScheme, Verified: October 2026

scheme_name: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC) Schemes
scheme_description: Concessional credit, mechanization subsidies, and sustainable alternative livelihood training to eliminate manual scavenging and rehabilitate sanitation workers.
eligibility: Safai Karamcharis, manual scavengers, waste collectors, and their legal dependents.
benefits_money: Concessional loans up to Rs 15,00,000 at 4% to 6% interest for alternative businesses, and capital subsidies up to Rs 5,00,000 for sewer-cleaning equipment under the Swachhata Udyami Yojana.
income_limit: No income ceiling for manual scavengers and safai karamcharis.
documents: Safai Karamchari identification certificate issued by local body / Municipality
application_process: Submit application through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs), Regional Rural Banks, or online via the NSKFDC / JanSamarth portal.
source_and_verification_date: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / myScheme, Verified: October 2026
